intro: Centaur Bracers are simple leather and iron armbands taken from slain Kolkar centaur throughout the Barrens. Regthar Deathgate collects them west of the Crossroads as proof of culled centaur raiders.

p: The Kolkar tribe poses an unrelenting threat to the Horde's foothold across the arid plains of the Barrens. Stripping the bracers from fallen centaur warriors serves as undeniable proof that another hostile marauder has been removed from the trade roads. Regthar Deathgate, an orc scout stationed along the bluffs west of the Crossroads, issues a standing bounty on these trophies to blunt the tribe's aggression.
